table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Icatcode,
	itemlog.itemrowid,
	category=(select itemcategory.name from itemcategory where itemlog.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode),
	Name, 
	customicode, 
	stock,  
	oldsaleprice = saleprice, 
	oldpackunits = packunits,
	newsaleprice = newsaleprice,
	newpackunits = ISNULL(
		(SELECT l.PackUnits 
		FROM ItemLog l 
		WHERE l.ItemRowID IN 
			(SELECT MIN(il.itemrowid) 
			FROM itemlog il 
			WHERE il.icode = itemlog.icode and 
				il.logdate > itemlog.logdate AND 
				il.itemrowid > itemlog.itemrowid
			GROUP BY il.icode)), (SELECT i.packunits FROM item i where itemlog.icode=i.icode)),
	oldunitprice=saleprice / case packunits when 0 then 1 else packunits end, 
	newunitprice=newsaleprice / ISNULL(
		(SELECT l.PackUnits 
		FROM ItemLog l 
		WHERE l.ItemRowID IN 
			(SELECT MIN(il.itemrowid) 
			FROM itemlog il 
			WHERE il.icode = itemlog.icode and 
				il.logdate > itemlog.logdate AND 
				il.itemrowid > itemlog.itemrowid
			GROUP BY il.icode)), (SELECT i.packunits FROM item i where itemlog.icode=i.icode)),
	date=logdate,
	username = (select users.username FROM users WHERE itemlog.usercode=users.usercode)
FROM itemlog
WHERE logdate >= :ar_startdate AND 
		logdate <= :ar_enddate AND 
		icatcode in (:ar_icatcode) AND 
		(saleprice <> newsaleprice OR 
			packunits <> ISNULL(
				(SELECT l.PackUnits FROM ItemLog l WHERE l.ItemRowID IN 
					(SELECT MIN(il.itemrowid)
					FROM itemlog il 
					WHERE il.ICode = itemlog.icode AND
						il.logdate > itemlog.logdate AND 
						il.itemrowid > itemlog.itemrowid)), (SELECT i.packunits FROM item i where itemlog.icode=i.icode)))
ORDER BY 
	icatcode, 
	logdate, 
	Name, 
	customicode
